titulo: A towel over the pot until we sit
caption:
A towel over the pot until we sit

The soup was ready and the table was not. A towel over the pot, and it was still hot when everyone sat down.

A towel over the pot costs nothing and keeps the soup hot until the last person gets to the table.

For whoever puts a towel over the pot to keep it hot until everyone sits.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. At the right a green soup pot with steam rising from it and, at the middle, a folded cream towel. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the towel hops in an arc and settles over the lid and the top of the pot, and the steam stops. A small sparkle lights above. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, keeping it hot under a towel.
